tools.name: buildium_list_rental_properties
tools.description: List rental properties (buildings) with address, unit count, type/subtype and manager. Filter by location (city/state contains), type, subtype, status, rental owner or property ids. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals.

tools.name: buildium_get_rental_property
tools.description: Fetch one rental property by id. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/{propertyId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_rental_units
tools.description: List rental units with unit number, bedrooms/bathrooms, size, market rent and whether each unit is listed or occupied. Filter by property. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/units.

tools.name: buildium_get_rental_unit
tools.description: Fetch one rental unit by id. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/units/{unitId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_rental_owners
tools.description: List rental owners (the landlords you manage for) with contact details, management-agreement dates and the property ids they own. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/owners.

tools.name: buildium_list_leases
tools.description: List leases with unit, dates, lease type/status, current tenants, rent/deposit account details and eviction flag. Filter by property, owner, unit number, tenant name, dates, lease type or status (Active/Past/Future). Buildium: GET /v1/leases.

tools.name: buildium_get_lease
tools.description: Fetch one lease by id, including tenants, cosigners, account details and move-out data. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/{leaseId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_outstanding_balances
tools.description: Delinquency report: leases that owe money, with aged buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days), total balance, past-due-email and eviction-pending dates. Leases with zero or credit balances are not returned. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/outstandingbalances.

tools.name: buildium_list_lease_transactions
tools.description: Read a lease's ledger: charges, payments, credits, refunds, deposits and other transactions with date, type, total amount and journal lines. Read-only — this server never posts to a ledger. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/{leaseId}/transactions.

tools.name: buildium_list_tenants
tools.description: List rental tenants with contact details, emergency contact, address and leases. Filter by name, email, phone, unit number, property, owner, unit ids or lease term status. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/tenants.

tools.name: buildium_get_tenant
tools.description: Fetch one rental tenant by id. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/tenants/{tenantId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_applicants
tools.description: List rental applicants with contact details, status and their applications. Filter by application status, unit, name, email, submission date or entity. Buildium: GET /v1/applicants.

tools.name: buildium_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders with title, status, priority, due date, vendor, amount, line items, linked task and bill ids. Filter by entity, status, priority, task type, unit, vendor, assignee, dates, amount, billed flag or title. Buildium: GET /v1/workorders.

tools.name: buildium_get_work_order
tools.description: Fetch one work order by id. Buildium: GET /v1/workorders/{workOrderId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks/requests — contact requests, resident requests, rental owner requests and to-dos — with category, property, unit, requester, assignee, status, priority and due date. Buildium: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: buildium_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (contractors, suppliers) with contact details, category, insurance and default expense GL account. Filter by name, email, phone, website, status or insurance expiration. Buildium: GET /v1/vendors.

tools.name: buildium_list_bills
tools.description: List vendor bills (accounts payable) with dates, memo, vendor, linked work order, reference number, approval status and lines. Read-only. Buildium: GET /v1/bills.

tools.name: buildium_list_gl_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts: GL accounts with number, name, type/subtype, sub-accounts and bank/credit-card flags. Useful for finding the gl_account_id for work order line items. Buildium: GET /v1/glaccounts.

tools.name: buildium_list_associations
tools.description: List community/HOA associations with address, manager, reserve, fiscal year and operating bank account. Buildium: GET /v1/associations.

tools.name: buildium_create_work_order
tools.description: Create a work order for a vendor. Attach it to an existing task (task_id) or create a new task with it (task: title, priority, status, assigned staff user, optional due date/property/unit). vendor_id and entry_allowed are required. Line items are optional (quantity x unit price, optional GL account)

tools.name: buildium_update_work_order
tools.description: Update a work order's details. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current work order first and only changes the fields you pass — everything else (including line items and entry contacts) is preserved. Passing line_items REPLACES all existing line items. Status/priority/due

tools.name: buildium_create_todo_task
tools.description: Create an internal to-do task assigned to a staff user, optionally tied to a property/unit and category, with a due date. Buildium: POST /v1/tasks/todorequests.

tools.name: buildium_update_todo_task
tools.description: Update a to-do task — change status (e.g. mark Completed), priority, assignee, due date, title or category, optionally with an update message. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current task first and only changes the fields you pass. Buildium: GET then PUT /v1/tasks/todoreq

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buildium_list_outstanding_balances, buildium_list_lease_transactions, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_update_todo_task · Private data: buildium_list_rental_owners, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_tasks, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_update_work_order, buildium_update_todo_task · Public sink: buildium_list_outstanding_balances, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_create_work_order, buildium_create_todo_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buildium_list_outstanding_balances, buildium_list_lease_transactions, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_update_todo_task · Private data: buildium_list_rental_owners, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_tasks, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_update_work_order, buildium_update_todo_task · Public sink: buildium_list_outstanding_balances, buildium_list_tenants, buildium_list_applicants, buildium_list_vendors, buildium_create_work_order, buildium_create_todo_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
